attchmntText: Pansari Developers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Pansari Developers Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 14th November 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Statutory Auditors Agarwal Vishwanath & Associates issued Limited Review Reports with unmodified opinions on these financial statements. The company reported total assets of 55,074.51 lakhs as of 30th September 2026, compared to 48,427.51 lakhs as of 31st March 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter was 1,531.39 lakhs. The results were placed before the Board for approval and are now submitted to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited.
